SEC. 3112. REVISION TO THE MEDICARE IMPROVEMENT FUND.

    Section 1898(b)(1)(A) of the Social Security Act (42 U.S.C. 1395iii) 
is amended by striking ``$22,290,000,000'' and inserting ``$0''.

[[Page 124 STAT. 422]]
